title: Physical Education
statementMd:
Vasya is a school PE teacher. Unlike other PE teachers, Vasya doesn't like it when the students stand in line according to their height. Instead, he demands that the children stand in the following order: $*a*_{1}, *a*_{2}, ..., *a*_{*n*}$, where $*a*_{*i*}$ is the height of the $*i*$-th student in the line and $*n*$ is the number of students in the line. The children find it hard to keep in mind this strange arrangement, and today they formed the line in the following order: $*b*_{1}, *b*_{2}, ..., *b*_{*n*}$, which upset Vasya immensely. Now Vasya wants to rearrange the children so that the resulting order is like this: $*a*_{1}, *a*_{2}, ..., *a*_{*n*}$. During each move Vasya can swap two people who stand next to each other in the line. Help Vasya, find the sequence of swaps leading to the arrangement Vasya needs. It is not required to minimize the number of moves.

## Input

The first line contains an integer $*n*$ ($1 ≤ *n* ≤ 300$) which is the number of students. The second line contains $*n*$ space-separated integers $*a*_{*i*}$ ($1 ≤ *a*_{*i*} ≤ 10^{9}$) which represent the height of the student occupying the $*i*$-th place must possess. The third line contains $*n*$ space-separated integers $*b*_{*i*}$ ($1 ≤ *b*_{*i*} ≤ 10^{9}$) which represent the height of the student occupying the $*i*$-th place in the initial arrangement. It is possible that some students possess similar heights. It is guaranteed that it is possible to arrange the children in the required order, i.e. $*a*$ and $*b*$ coincide as multisets.

## Output

In the first line print an integer $*k*$ ($0 ≤ *k* ≤ 10^{6}$) which is the number of moves. It is not required to minimize $*k*$ but it must not exceed $10^{6}$. Then print $*k*$ lines each containing two space-separated integers. Line $*p*_{*i*}$, $*p*_{*i*} + 1$ ($1 ≤ *p*_{*i*} ≤ *n* - 1$) means that Vasya should swap students occupying places $*p*_{*i*}$ and $*p*_{*i* + 1}$.
statementZhMd:
<statement>
Vasya 是一名学校体育老师。与其他体育老师不同，Vasya 不喜欢学生按照身高排队。相反，他要求孩子们按照以下顺序站队：$*a*_{1}, *a*_{2}, ..., *a*_{*n*}$，其中 $*a*_{*i*}$ 是队伍中第 $*i*$ 个学生的身高，$*n*$ 是队伍中学生的数量。孩子们很难记住这种奇怪的排列方式，而今天他们按照以下顺序排成了队：$*b*_{1}, *b*_{2}, ..., *b*_{*n*}$，这让 Vasya 非常生气。现在 Vasya 想重新排列孩子们，使最终的顺序变为：$*a*_{1}, *a*_{2}, ..., *a*_{*n*}$。每次操作中，Vasya 可以交换队伍中相邻的两个人。请帮助 Vasya，找出一系列交换操作，使队伍变为 Vasya 所要求的排列。不要求最小化操作次数。

## 输入格式

第一行包含一个整数 $*n*$（$1 ≤ *n* ≤ 300$），表示学生的数量。第二行包含 $*n*$ 个以空格分隔的整数 $*a*_{*i*}$（$1 ≤ *a*_{*i*} ≤ 10^{9}$），表示要求占据队伍中第 $*i*$ 个位置的学生所必须具有的身高。第三行包含 $*n*$ 个以空格分隔的整数 $*b*_{*i*}$（$1 ≤ *b*_{*i*} ≤ 10^{9}$），表示初始排列中占据队伍第 $*i*$ 个位置的学生的身高。可能存在一些学生身高相同。保证可以将孩子们排列成要求的顺序，即 $*a*$ 和 $*b*$ 作为多重集合相同。

## 输出格式

第一行输出一个整数 $*k*$（$0 ≤ *k* ≤ 10^{6}$），表示操作次数。不要求最小化 $*k*$，但其值不能超过 $10^{6}$。接下来输出 $*k*$ 行，每行包含两个以空格分隔的整数。第 $*i*$ 行中的 $*p*_{*i*}$、$*p*_{*i*} + 1$（$1 ≤ *p*_{*i*} ≤ *n* - 1$）表示 Vasya 应交换当前占据第 $*p*_{*i*}$ 个位置和第 $*p*_{*i* + 1}$ 个位置的学生。
</statement>
